## Conocimiento pendiente de promoción (a wiki)
- Envido idempotency is critical and counterintuitive: each team sings each canto at most ONCE. The "repetition" effect in the betting table comes from the RIVAL singing the same/higher canto, not the same team repeating it
- Partida ends the instant a team reaches 30 (or 15). State machine must check score after every scoring event and short-circuit if reached. This affects FE endgames at 29-29
- Timer 60s on every turn with auto IR AL MAZO is the cleanest rule; avoids distinguishing "disconnect" from "distraction" — same behavior
- Mazo in R1 before any canto = 2 points (1 implicit Envido + 1 implicit Truco). This is non-obvious but standard in truco

## Gotchas
- Do NOT confuse "envido repetition" (which doesn't exist for the same team) with "envido accumulation" (which does, via the rival raising)
- Score = 30 check must run after every scoring event, not just at hand end
- §16 changelog and Appendix D decisions live in different places by design: §16 = regulatory questions; Appendix D = product decisions
- User has now provided all clarifications needed; next phase is engine implementation, not more Q&A

## Instrucción de arranque
Read concept/truco-rules.md end-to-end to internalize the canonical rules. Open concept/truco-simulations.md and treat each SIM-NN as a unit test oracle. Begin the TypeScript engine implementation in `src/engine/` (or `engine/`), following the §17 state machine outline. Implement each module with a test that validates against the corresponding SIM scenario. The FE endgame (§10.3) and envido idempotency (§6.2-6.3) are the trickiest parts — design tests for those first.
